origin: reused from the frozen Stage 5b controlled vocabularies of the Fe/Ni corpus; no label was invented for the 12 development cases
rules: a label names the transformation class only
a label never contains a catalyst, a ligand, a yield, an ee or a substrate name
the same transformation always takes the same label
mixed_or_multiple is not a legal Gold label: a Gold target is one reaction
a label is assigned from the frozen corpus classification of the paper plus the substrate of the frozen target anchor

asymmetric_hydrogenation.ketone.definition: Direct asymmetric hydrogenation of an unsaturated substrate on a ketone/carbonyl substrate

asymmetric_hydrogenation.imine.definition: Direct asymmetric hydrogenation of an unsaturated substrate on a imine or c=n substrate

asymmetric_hydrogenation.alkene.definition: Direct asymmetric hydrogenation of an unsaturated substrate on a c=c substrate

asymmetric_hydrogenation.heteroarene.definition: Direct asymmetric hydrogenation of an unsaturated substrate on a aromatic heterocycle hydrogenation substrate

asymmetric_hydrogenation.alkyne_tandem.definition: Direct asymmetric hydrogenation of an unsaturated substrate on a alkyne plus amine or tandem reductive hydroamination case

asymmetric_hydrogenation.other.definition: Direct asymmetric hydrogenation of an unsaturated substrate on a other source-verified substrate class

transfer_or_relay_hydrogenation.other.definition: H2-driven relay/shuttle or biomimetic transfer process on a other source-verified substrate class
